tasks.gr9-cells-tissues-organisation-t1: Topic: Cells, Tissues and Levels of Organisation. Cover cell structure, organelles (nucleus, mitochondria, chloroplast, cell wall), tissues, organs, and systems. Ask learners to identify cell parts, compare plant and animal cells, explain organelle functions, or sequence the levels of organisation in living things.
tasks.gr9-human-body-systems-health-t1: Topic: Human Body Systems and Health. Cover the digestive, respiratory, circulatory, excretory, and reproductive systems; homeostasis; and healthy lifestyle choices. Ask learners to describe system roles, connect systems to health, identify healthy choices, or explain how systems work together.
